exception: Job 2590 exposed a duplicated BigQuery schema config defect; three test failures are genuine mandatory source-quality gates, not evidence to weaken tests.
source_excerpt: Job 2590: model success, 21 rows; PASS=30, ERROR=3. ledger_balanced=21 failures, nonnegative_amounts=10, valid_flags=21. Compiled relation: prd-dagen.payments_v1_payments_v1.mart_denormalized_transactions.

findings.message: Compiled model and tests target prd-dagen.payments_v1_payments_v1 instead of the contracted prd-dagen.payments_v1 because the profile dataset and project custom schema both contribute payments_v1.
findings.fix_hint: Remove the redundant project/model +schema: payments_v1 configuration (or implement a narrowly verified generate_schema_name override), then parse/compile and confirm the model and all tests resolve exactly to prd-dagen.payments_v1.mart_denormalized_transactions before retrying.

findings.message: The model built 21 rows, but real data violated mandatory controls: all 21 rows failed ledger/combined flags and 10 rows contained negative financial amounts. The compiled tests query the built relation correctly and implement the approved contract; this is source/business-quality failure, not credential/runtime failure.
findings.fix_hint: Do not weaken or delete the tests and do not coerce negative or ledger values silently. Inspect grouped failing reasons/fields from the materialized 21-row relation, then either remediate upstream source data or obtain explicit product approval for a documented quarantine/warning policy that preserves flags. Keep the existing error gates until such a policy is approved.
